column1: # Rows db.phi.* (line PS, item PS8a, 2026-11-23): psiblast -phi_pattern with one round (PHI-BLAST), frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; the pattern files are tests/fixtures/phi/*.pat

# Rows db.phi.st.*, lc.*, ax.*, xa.*, e1.*, elast.*, notq.11, notq.it3.*, brk.*, nohit.*, rej.sid.* (line PS, item PS8a fix round 1, 2026-11-24): the strategy of several PHI queries, subject masks, X-only queries, empty records, the order of NCBI's errors and LOSAT's refusals; inputs tests/fasta/psiblast/ps8_*.faa and tests/fixtures/phi/{c2c,x3,brknum}.pat

# Rows db.phi.cull.*, db.phi.bh.*, db.phi.rej.outfmt* (line PS, PR #1654 R2, 2026-11-26): phi_traceback preliminary-surviving HSP filtering under -culling_limit / -best_hit_* with -max_target_seqs 1 (inputs tests/fasta/psiblast/ps8_cull_{q,s}.faa and tests/fixtures/phi/cwh.pat), and -phi_pattern outfmt 1/18 refusals (replaced by db.phi.b.1 and db.phi.b.18, item PS8b)

# Rows db.phi.varlen.* (line PS, PR #1654 R3, 2026-11-26): same-start variable-length pattern hits (C-x(1,2)-C on CACC, tests/fixtures/phi/cx12c.pat and tests/fasta/psiblast/ps8_varlen_{q1,s1,q2,s2}.faa) under -culling_limit and -best_hit_* (PhiPrelimOrdinal selection and PhiOccurrenceIndex splitting)

# Rows db.phi.b.* (line PS, item PS8b, 2026-11-27): psiblast -phi_pattern with the rounds after the PHI-BLAST round 1, outfmt 1 to 5, 11 and 18, -html, the PSSM files of the rounds, the second SetOptions, a database sequence with the query's Seq-id under -parse_deflines (tests/db_search/ps8b_qid), outfmt 11 with rounds (tests/fasta/psiblast/ps8b_tk30.faa, an archive under 64 KB) and the taxonomy database's warnings of each occurrence; frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0. They replace PS8a's refusal rows db.phi.rej.it3, db.phi.rej.outfmt1, db.phi.rej.outfmt18 and db.phi.rej.html. Freeze them alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.phi.b.`.

# Rows db.phi.b.b90.*, db.phi.b.g10e2.*, db.phi.b.o2.*, db.phi.b.eo2.*, db.phi.b.taxids.*, db.phi.b.ntaxids.* (line PS, item PS8b fix round 1, 2026-11-28): BLAST XML of a PHI round whose matrix and gap costs have no pattern statistics (no search, the message and the footer of -1 values, the end of the document with rounds), the message of each occurrence's result (result i carries the batch's query i's; tests/fasta/psiblast/ps8b_o2.faa, ps8b_e_o2.faa), the database handler's posts again in the second SetOptions (-taxids, -negative_taxids on a database without taxonomy files) and LOSAT's refusal of the organism report of an unsearched PHI round
